intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Temple for 2026, and here is what he found: 13 family events, 6 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Christmas at the Plaza Tree Lighting and Holiday Market) through January 3, 2027 (Rink on the Rails), with Jingle Jam (December 4), Christmas on the Chisholm Trail in Belton (December 4 to 5), Santa at the Depot and the Holland Christmas Tree Lighting (December 5), the 80th Annual Temple Christmas Parade (December 7) and the Nutcracker Ballet at the Cultural Activities Center (December 11 to 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Temple

  • 13 Christmas events for kids in Temple and nearby Belton and Holland
  • 6 free events, including Christmas at the Plaza, Jingle Jam, Light Up for Literacy at the library, Santa at the CAC, the Holland tree lighting and the Christmas parade
  • Meet Santa: Santa at the Depot (December 5), Santa at the CAC (December 5), Milk and Cookies with Santa at Temple Civic Theatre (December 12) and Jingle All the Way for ages 3 to 5 (December 18)
  • Belton: Christmas on the Chisholm Trail in Downtown Belton (December 4 and 5), with the Grinch movie, tree lighting, Santa photos and the lighted parade; the host pages do not list a price
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Plaza tree lighting (November 28), Jingle Jam (December 4) and the 80th Annual Christmas Parade (December 7), plus the Holland tree lighting (December 5)
  • Shows: the Nutcracker Ballet (December 11 to 13) and Hometown Holidays at Temple Civic Theatre (December 17 to 20)
  • Trains: Santa arrives by train at the Temple Railroad and Heritage Museum on December 5
  • Season: November 28 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Temple families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Killeen, which covers Nature in Lights at Fort Hood, the Killeen tree lighting festival and the Killeen Christmas parade.
